subject: Catalyst Connector: Partner immersion & integration plan
messages:
From: Maria Castro <maria.castro@catalyst-consult.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Liu <dliu@devforge.io>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Catalyst Connector: Partner immersion & integration plan

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering team was impressed with the latency profiles and the routing options. Catalyst Consulting is excited to propose a structured immersion for our joint SI partners (we call it the "Connector Immersion"). The goal: get 3 teams from our integrator network productive with Redwood in 2 weeks (sandbox integration, two hands-on labs, and a runbook handoff).

High-level proposal (attached: Catalyst_Immersion_Agenda.pdf):
- Week 0 (prework): sandbox access + small integration checklist (API keys, model selection, sample prompts)
- Week 1 (2x half-day workshops): integration lab #1 (auth, routing, and model pinning), integration lab #2 (batching/caching and cost controls)
- Week 2 (handoff): runbook, joint demo, and mutual action plan delivery

We ask Redwood to provide:
1) a single point-of-contact for SI enablement (tech lead)
2) a short runbook template and an engineer for the hands-on lab (2 half-days)
3) sandbox credentials that mirror hosted behavior (quota/billing not required)

Proposed dates: Nov 29 — Dec 11 (flexible).

Would appreciate confirmation of availability and any constraints (security approvals, RBAC we should avoid, etc.).

Best,
Maria Castro
Partner Programs Lead | Catalyst Consulting
Attachments: Catalyst_Immersion_Agenda.pdf

--

From: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Castro <maria.castro@catalyst-consult.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Catalyst Connector: Partner immersion & integration plan

Maria — great to see this laid out, and congrats on the clear agenda. We're aligned on the outcomes and can support the three asks with a small cross-functional team. Quick notes: 

- Tech lead: I'll nominate Ben Carter to be the SI enablement lead for this run (owns lab content and day-of troubleshooting).
- Runbook template: Laura has a compact SI runbook we've used for similar partner pilots; I'll attach the internal matrix (Redwood_Roles_and_CommMatrix.pdf) and ask Laura to share the runbook doc.
- Sandbox: we can provision a sandbox project that emulates hosted API semantics but with a limited quota — Grace will own provisioning and token lifecycle.

Constraints / questions:
1) Security: will you need SOC 2 evidence or an IP/data-flow diagram for the sandbox? We can provide a redacted data flow and our SOC 2 attestation PDF via secure link.
2) Model scope: do you want us to include large context variants (32k) for the labs or stick to 8k for consistency across integrators?

Proposed smaller timeline (to limit friction): prep week Nov 22–27 (short checklist + sandbox), labs Nov 29–Dec 3, handoff Dec 6–10. If that works I'll ring-fence Ben and Grace for those windows.

I've attached: Redwood_Roles_and_CommMatrix.pdf (internal contact matrix).

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Roles_and_CommMatrix.pdf

Rafael / Ben —

I can take the runbook delivery. I reviewed Catalyst's agenda and mapped it to our standard lab modules — attaching the runbook and a small scripts bundle for the hands-on (SI-Lab-Runbook.md, SI-Lab-Scripts.zip). Key points for the team:
- Lab 1 (auth & routing): we will use API keys + example policy for routing by region. Bring a sample app that calls the /v1/generate endpoint.
- Lab 2 (cost controls): prepared prompt sets, batching examples, and a short segment on quantization recommendations.
- Handoff: mutual-action-plan.xlsx will be completed in the week after labs and shared with Catalyst and SI leads.

Logistics: Ben, please confirm your availability Nov 29 and Dec 1 for the half-day sessions. Grace — can you start sandbox provisioning tickets tomorrow?

Thanks — Laura
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SI-Lab-Runbook.md, SI-Lab-Scripts.zip

Maria / Daniel —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming the mini-sprint schedule and action owners below. Please find the mutual action plan attached (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) and a HubSpot reference to the opportunity (link in metadata).

Confirmed schedule:
- Prep: Nov 24–27 — Catalyst to distribute prework checklist; Redwood to provision sandbox by Nov 26 (Grace).
- Labs: Nov 29 (Lab 1) and Dec 1 (Lab 2) — half days, Ben leads content with Laura co-facilitating.
- Handoff & demo: Dec 8 — joint demo and MAP closure; mutual-action-plan.xlsx to be finalized by Dec 6.

Action owners:
- Redwood sandbox & token lifecycle: Grace O'Connor
- SI labs content & delivery: Ben Carter, Laura Bennett
- Partner logistics & agendas: Maria Castro (Catalyst)
- SI invites and configuration: Daniel Liu (DevForge)

Security note: Catalyst — we will provide a redacted data-flow diagram and SOC 2 attestation via a secure drive link if you confirm access email for the artifact.

Next steps: Maria, can you confirm the three SI teams and their primary contacts by Nov 24 so we can provision sandboxes? Once confirmed, I'll raise the provisioning tickets and share calendar blocks.

Looking forward — Rafael
Head of Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx
